targets.method: Population median sorts unreached after all observed times; deadline fraction always divides by all samples.

analysisScope: Complete100 adopted validation seeds only; no partial-seed analysis, tuning, new simulation, build or source/evaluator edit.
populationDefinition: All100 samples, null after finite times, floor((N-1)*q). Conditional success-only quantiles separate; no censoring replacement.
validationSeedUse: Outcome verification only. No numeric suggestion or optimization from validation raw.
